sheet.heading: Your emergency sheet
sheet.warning: Write this down or print it now. It is shown only once, and without it a forgotten master password cannot be recovered.
sheet.warning_new: Write this down or print it now. It is shown only once. The new key replaces the old one when you have typed it back.
sheet.new_browser: To recover the vault in a new browser you need both pages: the setup text (the QR code) and, if the account has one, the secret key from page 1, and the recovery key from page 2.
sheet.recovery_note: The recovery key opens the vault on its own, together with access to the server. Keep this page apart from page 1, in a different place.
sheet.page_one_unchanged: Page 1 does not change. Keep the page 1 you already have. This page replaces your old page 2 once a new backup of the server has been made; keep the old page 2 until then.
sheet.page_one_missing: Page 1 of the sheet could not be made, so the account is not created. Reload the page and start again.
sheet.http_warning: This server is reached over plain http. What you send to it, and the address on this sheet, is not protected on the network. Use https for real data.
sheet.qr_alt: QR code with the setup text
sheet.download_warning: The file holds your recovery key. Do not save it in a folder that is synced or backed up to the cloud (OneDrive, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive and the like). Save it to a removable drive or print it, and delete the copy afterwards.
sheet.download_done: The file was handed to your browser. Delete the copy once it is printed or stored offline.
sheet.download_failed: The PDF could not be made. Use Print instead.
sheet.confirm_note: The account is created only when both keys have been typed back and checked here.
sheet.confirm_heading_new: Type the new recovery key back
sheet.confirm_note_new: Type the whole new recovery key. Nothing changes until it has been checked here.
sheet.pdf.qr_text: Setup text (what the QR code holds)
sheet.qr_too_long: This address is too long for one QR code, so the sheet has no QR code. Use the setup text on page 1 instead.
